headline: Revenue and margins surge as tariff refunds boost profit
summary_short: Q2 revenue rose 32.1% y/y to $1,632.6M as Adjusted EBITDA margin expanded to 19.1% from 11.1%, aided by a one-time tariff-refund benefit; net income attributable to equity holders grew to $107.2M from $18.2M.
summary_long: Amer Sports posted broad-based Q2 growth: revenue rose 32.1% y/y to $1,632.6M, led by DTC (+39.9%) and Greater China (+35.5%). Gross margin expanded to 65.6% from 58.5%, helped by a 3.9-point tariff-refund benefit plus favorable mix, and Adjusted EBITDA margin rose to 19.1% from 11.1%. Net income attributable to equity holders grew to $107.2M from $18.2M, even after a $50.5M year-to-date loss on debt extinguishment tied to the March redemption of the company's senior secured notes. Cash and equivalents rose to $720.4M from $303.4M, with H1 operating cash flow of $338.5M versus $107.5M a year earlier. Management guides FY2026 capex to approximately $400M, up from $283.7M in 2025.
